thread:
Lena Ortiz: short vendor sync notes  need a concrete launch plan for H100/H200/B200, MI300, and Gaudi. main asks: SKU naming, image tags for marketplace, driver/firmware gating, and press embargo owner.
Priya Gupta: I can own embargo handshake but need the final SKU list + gating matrix by Fri EOD. also need approval from vendor and SI leads.
Samir Desai: ops flag: B200 shows sustained derate in our 8h inference soak. proposal: publish two SKUs: b200-sustained and b200-burst, with clear perf profiles. this will affect reservation pricing.
Carlos Mendez: SI certs require exact driver + runtime combos. I'll publish a small CSV with tested driver versions. example test command we run: ```nvidia-smi --format=csv --query-gpu=driver_version,gpu_name```
Vendor Ops Bot: vendor update: H200 firmware freeze 2025-05-14 UTC; Gaudi bringup patch 2025-05-18; MI300 kernel ABI landing 2025-05-20. Policy: post-freeze microcode changes require minor release and recert.
Lena Ortiz: important: if vendor enforces minor-release recert, runtime must support routing fallback to compatible model families (H100/MI300). @Samir can ops model cost/latency delta?
Samir Desai: yes, will run a quick cost/latency impact spreadsheet and share by Thu.
Priya Gupta: action list: 1) Carlos publish CI gating CSV by Thu; 2) Samir sketch B200 SKU copy + pricing by Thu; 3) Lena draft embargo slide + fallback message templates by Fri AM. react with :white_check_mark: when done.
Carlos Mendez: will upload CSV and include marketplace image tags (e.g., redwood/h100:2025-05, redwood/mi300:2025-05).
Vendor Ops Bot: reminder: next vendor bridge 2025-05-07 16:00 UTC.
Lena Ortiz: thanks all  short but actionable. will update product-announce doc after items land.
